lyrics:
[Intro: fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft bass]

[Verse 1: warm, plain, close]
Kettle's cold and the stairs don't creak
Radio's lost the will to speak
The house don't hum
The house don't hum
Since her suitcase hit the street

[Verse 2: strings enter, low and slow]
I wonder where she's laid her head
I wonder if she read what I said
The house don't hum
The house don't hum
There's a hollow in the bed

[Break: band stops except kick and bass, one breath]
And I wait, and I wait, and I wait, and I wait
I wait, I wait, I wait, I wait
I wait, I wait, I wait, I wait
I wait, I wait, I wait, I wait
I ought to go and find her
But I wait

[Verse 3: strings fuller, voice the same]
Clock's still ticking but it's lost its nerve
Dog's at the window, staring at the kerb
The house don't hum
The house don't hum
It's more quiet than I deserve

[Outro: guitar and strings, the title twice, stop]
The house don't hum
The house don't hum
